messages:
maya: Customer on dedicated reported a sudden failure in their ingestion pipeline after our version lock yesterday. They say the vector width changed mid-run — their index expects length 1536 but the API returned 1024. Full customer error: "vector length mismatch: expected 1536, got 1024"

infra-bot: deploy: pinned model variant redwood/titan-emb-v3-locked@2024-11-07 applied to tenant-678 (dedicated). Canary=0.05, region=us-west-2 :rocket:

leo: Can you paste the exact request + response they used? Need to confirm it's coming from our embeddings endpoint and not a downstream transform. Also any request_id? :eyes:

maya: Paste from customer (redacted):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood/titan-emb-v3-locked","input":"hello world"}'
```
Response body (abbreviated):
```
{ "data": [{ "embedding": [0.001, -0.23, ..., 1024 entries total] }], "model": "redwood/titan-emb-v3-locked" }
```
Customer noted their vector store throws error on upsert with expected_dim=1536. They tried to re-pin to the older variant and got 409 on the re-pin API.

eli: Quick hypothesis: model registry metadata and the compiled runtime weights misaligned after the pinned deploy. Either the artifact we pointed to changed embedding head size (new training/config) or a conversion/quantization step replaced a model but kept the same variant id. Check model manifest + sha256 vs artifact store. Also check recent changes in the onboarding pipeline that touch embedding_head_size.

leo: Verified in logs for tenant-678 at 1975304123: serve.start -> model_id=redwood/titan-emb-v3-locked, artifact_sha=sha256:aa11bb, model_manifest.emb_dim=1024. But catalog entry in the UI still listed 1536 (old value). So metadata drift for sure.

maya: Customer is blocked — index upserts failing. They asked for an ETA on a rollback or workaround. Any fast mitigation we can offer while eng-ml investigates? :thinking:

leo: Short-term mitigation options:
- Offer them a pad/truncate shim on our side to convert 1024 -> 1536 (risk: semantics).
- Force re-deploy of the previous artifact (if we still have sha stored) and re-pin.
- Provide a small client-side snippet to pad vectors before upsert until we fix the variant.

eli: I can add a temporary server-side compat layer per-tenant (feature flag) to pad with zeros to 1536 for upserts, and log a metric for padded_upserts. That buys time. We'll also prevent any new canary promotions until we finish root-cause.

maya: Customer prefers server-side if possible. They've paused production. Please escalate.

leo: Filed internal ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-20321 — title: "Pinned variant artifact/manifest drift -> embedding width mismatch". Assigned to eng-ml + infra. Included artifact shas and customer trace.

eli: Action plan: (1) enable per-tenant padding flag for tenant-678 (hotfix) (2) verify artifact store and reconcile manifest -> if previous sha exists, initiate rollback to sha256:zz99yy and recompile kernels (3) add a registry check that fails promotions when manifest emb_dim != compiled artifact emb_dim.

leo: On it. Starting rollback verification now. ETA for hotfix: ~1h for flag + smoke test. ETA for full rollback depends on artifact restore.

maya: Communicated to customer: we'll enable compat shim and follow up with root-cause/rollback timeline. They responded :thumbsup:.

eli: Also adding postmortem action: ensure variant pin operations include artifact immutability guarantees and automated manifest validation.

leo: Quick repro steps I used to confirm locally:
```
# reproduce locally against staging model snapshot
curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_KEY" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood/titan-emb-v3-locked","input":["a","b"]}' | jq .data[0].embedding | length
# expected 1536 for old artifact, got 1024 for new
```

maya: Thanks. I'll keep the ticket updated and loop in AE to notify the customer when the hotfix lands. :white_check_mark:

leo: hotfix flag enabled for tenant-678 at 1975304195, validated upsert succeeded with padding. Patching logs to include padded_upsert=true.

eli: Leaving follow-ups in INF-20321 for manifest validation and deployment gating. Assigning back to eng-ml for artifact reconciliation.

maya: Great work team. Customer is back to ingesting. Closing loop once INF-20321 has RCA and rollback or registry fix. :eyes:
